north_star: Increase monthly new-category adoption among existing Instamart shoppers without harming core replenishment trust.

core_metrics.name: new-category add-to-order rate
core_metrics.definition: Share of eligible sessions/orders that add an item from a category not purchased in the prior 30–90 days.

core_metrics.name: adjacent-category trial conversion
core_metrics.definition: Share of users exposed to a category-expansion intervention who purchase from the promoted adjacent category.

core_metrics.name: new-category browse depth
core_metrics.definition: Average number of distinct non-staple categories opened per session among exposed users.

core_metrics.name: 30-day category expansion retention
core_metrics.definition: Share of first-time category triers who purchase from that category again within 30 days.

guardrail_metrics.name: overall order conversion
guardrail_metrics.definition: Orders / sessions for exposed cohort vs control.

guardrail_metrics.name: customer support contacts per order
guardrail_metrics.definition: Support tickets or in-app help starts per completed order.

guardrail_metrics.name: refund or cancellation rate
guardrail_metrics.definition: Share of orders with refund, replacement, or cancellation.

guardrail_metrics.name: expansion-prompt dismiss rate
guardrail_metrics.definition: Share of users who dismiss or ignore category-expansion prompts.

measurement_notes: Do not claim causality from observational feedback alone.
Prefer holdout or A/B tests for all priority hypotheses.
Segment results by family_household and habitual_replenisher first.
Report Play Store complaint bias as a research caveat in every pilot readout.
